nodes.label: JWT Auth + Role-Based Access Control
nodes.rationale: JWT access (15 min) + refresh (7 days), server-side role enforcement across 5 roles (patient, family_caregiver, asha_worker, clinician, admin). Refresh enables low-connectivity re-login. No implicit caregiver access — each caregiver-to-patient access needs an active CaregiverPatientLink + ConsentRecord and is audited.

nodes.label: DPDP Act 2023 Compliance
nodes.rationale: DPDP Act 2023 as a first-class feature, not a layer: explicit consent scopes (game_data/health_data/voice_companion) with patient_self/guardian/joint types, immutable AuditLog, AES-256 column encryption at rest, purpose-limitation enforcement, and retention policy with soft-delete + 30-day-grace hard-delete on revocation.

nodes.label: Caregiver Dashboard on Flutter Web (shared models)
nodes.norm_label: caregiver dashboard on flutter web (shared models)
nodes.rationale: Dashboard built as Flutter Web reusing shared Dart models from the mobile app — a single Dart codebase eliminates model-sync bugs and avoids a separate React team; responsive for ASHA workers on tablets in the field.

nodes.label: Multilingual MVP Scope (NER languages)
nodes.rationale: Ship Assamese, Bengali, Hindi, English (highest NER coverage). Further languages (Manipuri/Meitei, Khasi, Mizo, Nepali, Bodo) added config-only as Bhashini pipeline IDs with no code changes; responses accept a ?language= param, preferred_language stored per user.

nodes.label: MVP Cognitive Baseline (healthy → MCI)
nodes.rationale: Targets healthy elderly through Mild Cognitive Impairment; defers moderate/severe dementia to v2 to focus UX and game difficulty curves on the most addressable cohort and ship a faster, clinically credible MVP. Dementia-friendly modes warrant a separate phase.

nodes.label: Offline-First Gaming + Sync Queue Architecture
nodes.rationale: Games fully playable offline; mobile stores sessions/reminders in local SQLite (drift) SyncQueue, background service polls every 30s and replays to an idempotent /sync endpoint on reconnect. NER connectivity is spotty so offline is non-negotiable; conflict-free for MVP (offline sessions are fresh inserts).

nodes.label: Reminder Escalation Thresholds
nodes.rationale: 10 min unacknowledged → secondary re-prompt; 3 missed same-type reminders in 7 days → AlertFlag to family + ASHA. Thresholds catch medication non-compliance early without over-prompting or false alarms; evaluated by an APScheduler job over ReminderEvent history.

nodes.label: Voice Companion (Bhashini + Claude)
nodes.rationale: ASR (patient's local language via Bhashini) → Claude (English reasoning) → TTS (local language). LanguageServiceProvider abstracts Bhashini for pluggability; system prompt DB-versioned so persona updates need no code change. Voice is essential to include low-literacy elderly.

nodes.label: Adaptive Difficulty Engine (strategy pattern)
nodes.rationale: Pluggable strategy pattern (DifficultyStrategy interface + RuleBasedDifficultyStrategy). MVP rules bump difficulty after 3 consecutive sessions >85% accuracy, drop after 2 consecutive <50%. Thresholds hardcoded (tune in code, no config); swappable for an ML model later without touching game code.

nodes.label: RAG Pipeline for Medical Documents (Phase 10)
nodes.rationale: Overlap chunking, stable embeddings (heuristic provider in CI/tests, sentence-transformers in prod), threshold vector search over pgvector, and cited extractive answers with Claude synthesis when ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is present; degrades to extractive-only otherwise. Exposed at /reports/documents/answer.

nodes.label: eldercare_dashboard (Caregiver Web Dashboard package)
nodes.rationale: Flutter Web caregiver dashboard; minimal deps (http, shared_preferences) — talks to the backend REST API.

nodes.label: backend service (FastAPI)
nodes.rationale: FastAPI app built from ./backend, hot-reload via ./backend/app volume mount; ENABLE_BACKGROUND_JOBS=true. Starts only after db and redis report healthy.

nodes.label: db service (PostgreSQL + pgvector)
nodes.rationale: pgvector/pgvector:pg16 image — single Postgres serves relational + vector (RAG) data, avoiding a second datastore. Healthcheck-gated (pg_isready).

nodes.label: redis service (cache/queue)
nodes.rationale: redis:7-alpine for session cache, rate limiting, and APScheduler broker; healthcheck via redis-cli ping. Not yet exercised at runtime.

nodes.label: eldercare_mobile (Patient Mobile App package)
nodes.rationale: Flutter patient app with offline-first stack: drift + sqlite3_flutter_libs, flutter_local_notifications + timezone, http + shared_preferences, intl/localizations.

nodes.label: Phase 12: Production Hardening
nodes.rationale: CORS whitelist via CORS_ORIGINS, Redis-backed rate limiting (100 req/min/IP — first real Redis use), strict env secrets with fail-fast on placeholders, GitHub Actions CI booting a Postgres service for alembic upgrade + smoke_e2e, and an OWASP-ish pass (bandit, dependency scan).

nodes.label: RAG pipeline (chunk -> embed -> pgvector -> Claude)
nodes.rationale: Overlap chunking -> embeddings -> retrieval (cosine + min_similarity) -> Claude-grounded cited answer with disclaimer. Currently heuristic md5-weighted-TF vectors stored in a JSON column; Phase 14 moves to a real multilingual embedding model (e5-small vs text-embedding-3-small) and pgvector vector(N) + HNSW index (migration 0002). Claude has no embeddings API.

nodes.label: Sync-queue consumer (outbox -> encrypted SymptomLog)
nodes.rationale: Current /sync is an inert outbox — process_sync_batch writes sync_queue rows and marks them synced immediately with nothing consuming them. Phase 11 adds a consumer to drain sync_queue and materialize offline_symptom payloads into encrypted SymptomLog rows (respecting retry_count/last_error).

nodes.label: Offline-first mobile layer (drift outbox)
nodes.rationale: app_database.dart (drift tables: game sessions, actions, reminder events, sync outbox, routines) + offline_sync_service.dart + reminder_scheduler.dart make the patient app work on spotty NER networks. syncNow replays queued game sessions (start->actions->complete) and reminder acks via the live API, pushes generic payloads to POST /api/v1/sync, and purges synced outbox rows after 7 days. Requires build_runner codegen of app_database.g.dart (not committed).

nodes.label: Offline-First Sync Queue Architecture (Phase 1 design)
nodes.rationale: NER has spotty connectivity, so offline capability is non-negotiable. Games playable fully offline; SyncQueue model records offline actions (create/update/delete) by resource_type and syncs on reconnect. Offline-created sessions are fresh INSERTs — no conflict resolution needed for MVP (last-write-wins deferred to v2).

nodes.label: Column-level AES-256 encryption at rest (unwired)
nodes.rationale: EncryptionService (Fernet/AES-256) exists but SymptomLog.notes and MedicalDocument.extracted_text are stored plaintext despite the 'encrypted at rest' comment. Phase 11 routes them through encrypt on write / decrypt on read at the service layer.

nodes.label: Phase 11: DPDP Compliance Pass
nodes.rationale: Input-independent backend pass: close access-control gaps, wire read-audit on health-data reads, consent-scope (purpose-limitation) gates, column-level AES-256 encryption at the service layer, retention/deletion + 30-day-grace jobs, and a sync-queue consumer. Consent posture decided strict (403).

nodes.label: DPDP Compliance Foundation (ConsentRecord + AuditLog)
nodes.rationale: DPDP Act 2023 built as a first-class feature from day 1, not bolted on later: ConsentRecord (consent_type game_data/health_data/voice_companion, scope patient_self/guardian/joint) captured before any health-data storage; immutable AuditLog (read/write/delete); column-level AES-256 encryption at rest for sensitive fields.

nodes.label: Access-control gaps (reminders/dashboard/companion)
nodes.rationale: Verified gaps: GET /reminders/patients/{id}/events, GET /reminders/schedules/{id}, and GET /dashboard/patients/{id}/summary accept any authenticated user with no ownership/link check; companion chat allows any non-patient role without an active link. Fix by promoting _can_view_patient from patients.py to a shared dependency.

nodes.label: JWT Auth + RBAC (Phase 1 design)
nodes.rationale: AuthService with bcrypt hashing + JWT (access 15m / refresh 7d) is stateless and scales horizontally; refresh tokens let rural field workers re-login without password in low-connectivity areas. require_role dependency factory enforces roles (patient/family_caregiver/asha_worker/clinician/admin) server-side.

nodes.label: Phase 13: Live External Services (Bhashini + Claude)
nodes.rationale: Flip the Bhashini provider off mock with a real key (ASR/TTS/NMT on NER-language audio); set ANTHROPIC_API_KEY for non-fallback companion replies + RAG answer synthesis with citations; integration test gate skips when keys absent.

nodes.label: Pluggable LanguageServiceProvider (Bhashini/Mock)
nodes.rationale: Abstract LanguageServiceProvider (transcribe/synthesize/translate) lets Bhashini be swapped for Google/Whisper/local LLM without touching call sites. MVP ships MockLanguageProvider via get_language_provider(); BhashiniProvider activates once API keys are configured.
